artifacts.notes: Complete scanned 1859 volume I: 374 PDF pages, including preface and commentary; the specified sermon occupies printed pp. 132–135 (PDF pp. 136–139); PDF p. 140, printed p. 136, begins the following sermon. Volume II is not in this separate volume-I artifact. The historical English translates surviving Syriac and identified Greek-catena supplements, not an uninterrupted Greek original. Sermon XXXVI at pp. 132–135 includes a Syriac lacuna supplemented from Greek and additional fragments in note r. Original Greek/Syriac counterpart absent from this run’s receipts; no new source-language edition was retrieved.
artifacts.rights_basis: The identified 1859 printing is public domain in the United States by publication date. The exact artifact is a mechanical facsimile or uncorrected OCR of that printing; digitizer identification adds factual provenance, not a new edition of the work.

alternate_titles: Homilies on the Gospel of Saint Luke
work.author: Cyril of Alexandria
work.description: Cyril of Alexandria's homiletic commentary on Luke, surviving substantially in a Syriac version and partly in Greek catena fragments. It is conventionally cited by sermon number; sermons 4 and 5 treat the Presentation in the Temple and the finding of the boy Jesus.
work.title: Commentary on the Gospel of Saint Luke
